svg.title: When a request of Paperless Sync may reach an address of the local network
svg.desc: Every request of the app goes to the saved Paperless URL. With the setting Paperless runs in my local network on, Nextcloud allows a local address for this request and sends it. With the setting off, Nextcloud sends it only when the address is not a local one; a local address is refused, and the app says to turn the setting on. The requests of other apps keep Nextcloud's protection either way.
